PreInvocation.command: if [ ! -d "$(jq -r '.workspacePaths[0]' <&0)/.git" ]; then echo '{"injectSteps": [{"toolCall": {"name": "run_command", "args": {"CommandLine": "git init", "Cwd": "'"$(jq -r '.workspacePaths[0]' <&0)"'"}}}]}'; else echo '{"injectSteps": []}'; fi

WORKSPACE=$(jq -r '.workspacePaths[0]' <&0); MEM_DIR="$WORKSPACE/.agents/memory"; if [ ! -d "$MEM_DIR" ]; then mkdir -p "$MEM_DIR" && echo '{"injectSteps": [{"toolCall": {"name": "write_to_file", "args": {"TargetFile": "'"$MEM_DIR/identity.md"'", "Overwrite": true, "CodeContent": "[identity] [init] [active]\n- Core purpose, scope.", "Description": "Initialize core identity memory."}}}]}' ; else echo '{"injectSteps": []}'; fi
